parsed.rationale: Although both records are `type-alias-object` kinds with `shared_field_count: 2` and neither is test, codegen, mock, or sample-app code, they carry distinct names (`PauseWXYC` in `Shared/Intents/Sources/Intents/PauseWXYC.swift` vs. `WhatsPlayingOnWXYC` in `WXYC/iOS/Intents.swift`) that strongly suggest they represent different Siri/App Intents actions — one for pausing playback and one for querying what is currently playing. The structural similarity (both are type aliases wrapping an intent object with the same two fields) is a consequence of the App Intents framework's uniform shape for intent types, not a sign of accidental duplication. Merging or extracting them would conflate two semantically distinct user-facing intent actions.
